statement: A first word exceeding the bound MUST be hard-cut -- the only permitted mid-word cut.
note: The first word is 61 characters -- one over the bound -- so there is no earlier `-` to truncate at. The slug MUST be hard-cut to 60. An implementation that returns the whole first word because 'the word-boundary rule found no boundary' emits the 61-character non-conformant slug shown, leaving the slug unbounded exactly when the bound matters most.
